title: Historical census-confirmed semantic misalignment of the Davis--Kahan Section 2 sin Theta theorem
purpose: Make historical source-exact/canonical sine-theta statements directly comparable without inferring defects merely from renames, refactors, or stronger supporting theorems.

inclusion_policy.include: A theorem snapshot only appears in misalignment_events when the maintained S2-sin-theta census/result-ledger history explicitly corrected, demoted, or superseded it as canonical/source-exact evidence for a source-correspondence reason.
inclusion_policy.exclude: Mere renames, implementation refactors, supporting/generalizing theorems that were never used as the canonical source witness, and reviewer inferences not recorded by the maintained census are excluded.
inclusion_policy.source_exact_meaning_here: The declaration was used as semantic_review canonical evidence / primary source witness for S2-sin-theta. The Lean identifier need not literally contain `sourceExact`.
inclusion_policy.retracted_findings: Census findings later explicitly retracted as false positives are kept separately and are not counted as confirmed misalignment events.

semantic_alignment_policy.summary: Semantic alignment is source-to-statement agreement on hypotheses, mathematical objects, conclusion, and scope; non-obvious representations also need their identification established. Lean compilation alone is insufficient.

signature_capture.method: Read the file at the recorded Git commit with `git show <commit>:<path>`, locate the exact theorem declaration, and copy its source header through the top-level `:=` / `:= by` line.
signature_capture.hashes: signature_sha256 hashes that verbatim header; source_file_sha256 hashes the full historical Lean file.
signature_capture.compiler_identity: When the historical census carried a statement pin for the exact declaration at that snapshot, it is copied as census_statement_pin. No historical checkout/build is synthesized just to invent a missing pin.
signature_capture.tooling_decision: No new leanq command is required for this dataset. Git already supplies the historical source exactly, and the repository formalization-process evidence builder already uses the same git-show style of historical declaration extraction.

theorem sinTheta_unbounded_intervalExterior_characterizedWitness_rclike
    [ContinuousLinearMap.HasMinMaxLowerBoundEverywhere.{u, v} 𝕜]
    [HasUnboundedSylvesterKyFan.{u, v} 𝕜]
    (N : UnitaryInvariantNorm)
    (A : E →ₗ.[𝕜] E)
    (A₀ : F →ₗ.[𝕜] F)
    (Λ₁ : G →ₗ.[𝕜] G)
    (E₀ : F →L[𝕜] E)
    (F₀ : H →L[𝕜] E)
    (F₁ : G →L[𝕜] E)
    (sinTheta₀ : F →L[𝕜] E)
    (R : F →L[𝕜] E)
    (hSinTheta₀ :
      sinTheta₀ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 E - F₀ ∘L F₀.adjoint) ∘L E₀)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A)
    (hA₀ : IsSelfAdjoint A₀)
    (hΛ₁ : IsSelfAdjoint Λ₁)
    (htrial : IsTrialResidual A A₀ E₀ R)
    (hexact : IsExactSpectralDecomposition A Λ₁ F₀ F₁)
    {β α δ : ℝ}
    (hβα : β ≤ α)
    (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hspectral :
      (LinearPMap.realSpectrum A₀ ⊆ Set.Icc β α ∧
          LinearPMap.realSpectrum Λ₁ ⊆
            {x : ℝ | x ≤ β - δ ∨ α + δ ≤ x}) ∨
        (LinearPMap.realSpectrum Λ₁ ⊆ Set.Icc β α ∧
          LinearPMap.realSpectrum A₀ ⊆
            {x : ℝ | x ≤ β - δ ∨ α + δ ≤ x}))
    (hR : N.Mem R) :
    δ * N.gauge sinTheta₀ ≤ N.gauge R := by
